name: Support FAQ v1
description: 10 canonical customer-support questions with reference answers. Load this in Datasets, then use it in an Experiment to compare models/prompts.

items.expected_output: Refunds are processed within 5 business days.

items.input: I forgot my password. How do I reset it?
items.expected_output: Use the 'Forgot password' link on the login page to reset it.
Support is available 9am-6pm Eastern, Monday to Friday.
No, support runs Monday to Friday only.

items.input: How do I export my invoices?
items.expected_output: Go to Billing then Invoices and click Export to download them.

items.input: Can I upgrade my plan mid-cycle?
items.expected_output: Yes. Upgrades take effect immediately and are prorated for the current cycle.

items.input: Where do I change my billing email?
items.expected_output: Update it under Settings then Billing then Billing contact.

items.input: My payment failed. What should I do?
items.expected_output: Check the card details under Billing and retry; contact support if it keeps failing.

items.input: How do I delete my account?
items.expected_output: Account deletion is under Settings then Danger Zone; it is permanent.
Yes, data is encrypted in transit and at rest.
